status: number-only fixture of our own: re-typed numbers of the stored caption chunk and template-apply responses (wave 2 + wave 3)
cleanRoom: Only numbers, our own field names, Tears of Steel dialogue (CC BY 3.0, Blender Foundation) and our own TTS texts. No Xapp code, prompt, skill or chat text, no Xapp ids. The CC BY 4.0 song lyrics of W3-RF-15 are masked (textMasked).
ruleUnderTest: Xapp code-level findings part 3 (C).md section 44.2 (chunking and timing rule)
units: seconds, rounded to 3 decimals; startS/endS are TIMELINE seconds exactly as sent to / returned by the server (before the client's item-end clamp and next-caption clip)
compare: same chunk count, same text partition (exact string), startS and endS within 1 ms

fields.source.wave / source.ref: where the stored pair comes from (wave-2 recorder body time stamp and step, or the wave-3 request row W3-RF-xx with the body file's epoch-ms time stamp)
fields.kind: manual = Captions panel / agent chunk request; template = template apply (limits come from the template, not the request)
fields.sourceItems: label -> corpus file in the fixture store and the offset with timeline second = source second + offset (speed 1); labels are ours, numbered by first appearance in the word list
fields.options.maxWords / options.maxCharacters: limits as sent (manual) or the template's portrait-layer limits (template)
fields.options.breakOnPunctuation / options.bre: break flags as sent; for template cases the request carries no flags (server default: both on)
fields.omittedOptions: flags the request did NOT send (agent path): the rule must treat them as on
fields.options.range: timeline range of the generation; the word list is already filtered to the words fully inside it (applying the filter again must be a no-op)
fields.options.template: template name (our label), canvas and layer; textTransform 'uppercase' means the returned chunk text is upper-cased
fields.wordList: input words in the order sent: text, startS, endS (timeline seconds), sourceItem label
fields.expectedChunks: server result: chunk text, startS, endS
fields.textMasked: true when the words are not Tears of Steel / our TTS text and were masked (see maskRule)
